title: Premium short-form video
summary: High-budget short videos made for mobile.
whyItFails: Free competition. TikTok and YouTube are free. Expensive content. High production costs. Unclear demand. Users don't pay for short content.

attempts.notes: Raised $1.75 billion and closed about eight months after launch.

attempts.outcome: Bought by Verizon and shut down
attempts.notes: Subscription video from a Hulu co-founder.

reasons.detail: Free competition: TikTok and YouTube are free.
Unclear demand: Users don't pay for short content.
